verdict.rationale: MCP integration lives in the host rather than in Skills itself. Claude Code connects to external MCP servers (docs-57, docs-81), with admin controls over which servers run (docs-82). The plugin packaging that distributes skills can also bundle MCP servers alongside skills (docs-6, docs-70), and the Agent SDK supports MCP-backed custom tools (docs-89). Community notes that skills complement MCP and can serve as light instructions for using it (comm-10, comm-16). missing for 10: a Skills-native mechanism for a SKILL.md to declare or wire up MCP servers, documentation of MCP inside the Skills spec or Skills API, and hands-on corroboration of a skill driving MCP tools.
